items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment and admit no new spend or implementation this cycle. Revenue claims are not supportable beyond $4.92 aggregate Amazon commission for 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items, with all commission in the unassignable aggregate row. Site-attributed revenue is $0. AI usage cost was $997.52 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 across 5,522 calls, so contribution margin, payback, and ROI are not calculable; the comparison is also period-mismatched. Preserve the queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement only as a slot-gated learning test, measuring registered affiliate clicks rather than revenue. Do not forecast lift from 61 baseline clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission.

Attribution disposition: retain registered site tracking IDs and reject allocation of the 629 aggregate clicks, 28 ordered items, and $4.92 commission to any site. The minimum measurement needed for site contribution margin is a dated provider export keyed to registered site tracking IDs, plus hosting/infrastructure, domain, labor, and other direct-cost amounts for the same period. Current AI-only margin figures are incomplete and must not be presented as contribution margin.

AI-spend disposition: $997.51762695 is known for September 2026, including 234 errors and 5 transient errors, but cost-to-learn is not calculable because experiment-level incremental AI cost, exposure, control performance, and attributable outcome deltas are not recorded. Use existing records to report those fields where available; do not request duplicate telemetry or authorize new AI spend while delivery is saturated.
